description: The map module’s region and jurisdiction vocabulary (packages/core/docs/geopolitical-layer.md §3 and docs/map-surface.md): which region contains this point, which authority claims it, what the land under it is, and where a place and the actor standing in it are. Each case carries src/geo/region-predicates.ts verbatim in its kb, followed by the case content, so a harness in any language runs it unaided. Every coordinate is an INTEGER on the ×100 grid geoUnit() mints, because a containment test that came out differently on two runtimes would decide whether an act was a crime. Four cases are the file’s teeth: the strip between two countries belongs to nobody, a point on a border is inside, two states of identical size are separated by a TOTAL order rather than by enumeration order, and a settlement standing outside its own chain is REPORTED as a conflict rather than silently resolved. What this file cannot pin is the map surface an engine draws — no rule computes one — which is conformance/map/, nor the territorial law, whose clause calls the substrate’s norm/2 and is proved in a KB carrying both packs. Regenerate with `npm run map-corpus`.

cases.name: the-pack-alone-answers-nothing-and-raises-nothing
cases.note: The no-existence_error contract. A KB with no regions at all must make every goal FAIL — the runner throws on a raise, so this case cannot pass by erroring.
kb: region_extent(R, rect(MinX, MinZ, MaxX, MaxZ)) :- region_bounds(R, MinX, MinZ, MaxX, MaxZ).
region_extent(R, disc(Cx, Cz, Rad)) :- region_disc(R, Cx, Cz, Rad).
region_extent_contains(rect(MinX, MinZ, MaxX, MaxZ), X, Z) :- X >= MinX, X =< MaxX, Z >= MinZ, Z =< MaxZ.
region_extent_contains(disc(Cx, Cz, Rad), X, Z) :- DX is X - Cx, DZ is Z - Cz, DX * DX + DZ * DZ =< Rad * Rad.
region_extent_area(rect(MinX, MinZ, MaxX, MaxZ), S) :- S is (MaxX - MinX) * (MaxZ - MinZ).
region_extent_area(disc(_, _, Rad), S) :- S is 4 * Rad * Rad.
in_region(X, Z, R) :- region_extent(R, E), region_extent_contains(E, X, Z).
region_size(R, S) :- region_extent(R, E), region_extent_area(E, S).
smaller_region(A, B) :- region_size(A, SA), region_size(B, SB), SA < SB.
smaller_region(A, B) :- region_size(A, SA), region_size(B, SB), SA =:= SB, A @< B.
region_at(X, Z, Kind, R) :- in_region(X, Z, R), region_kind(R, Kind), \+ ( in_region(X, Z, Other), region_kind(Other, Kind), smaller_region(Other, R) ).
position_terrain(X, Z, T) :- in_region(X, Z, R), region_terrain(R, T), \+ ( in_region(X, Z, Other), region_terrain(Other, _), smaller_region(Other, R) ).
position_biome(X, Z, B) :- in_region(X, Z, R), region_biome(R, B), \+ ( in_region(X, Z, Other), region_biome(Other, _), smaller_region(Other, R) ).
position_watershed(X, Z, W) :- in_region(X, Z, R), region_watershed(R, W), \+ ( in_region(X, Z, Other), region_watershed(Other, _), smaller_region(Other, R) ).
jurisdiction_above(S, C) :- jurisdiction_parent(S, St), jurisdiction_parent(St, C).
innermost_jurisdiction(X, Z, J) :- political_kind(Kind), region_at(X, Z, Kind, J), \+ ( political_kind(OtherKind), region_at(X, Z, OtherKind, Other), smaller_region(Other, J) ).
position_jurisdiction(X, Z, Level, J) :- innermost_jurisdiction(X, Z, J), jurisdiction_level(J, Level).
position_jurisdiction(X, Z, Level, J) :- innermost_jurisdiction(X, Z, Inner), jurisdiction_above(Inner, J), jurisdiction_level(J, Level).
jurisdiction_conflict(X, Z, J) :- political_kind(Kind), region_at(X, Z, Kind, J), \+ position_jurisdiction(X, Z, _, J).
place_jurisdiction(P, Level, J) :- place_position(P, X, Z), position_jurisdiction(X, Z, Level, J).
place_jurisdiction(P, Level, J) :- jurisdiction_of(P, Level, J).
place_jurisdiction(P, Level, J) :- place_of_settlement(P, S), jurisdiction_of(S, Level, J).
jurisdiction_of(J, Level, Above) :- jurisdiction_level(J, _), jurisdiction_above(J, Above), jurisdiction_level(Above, Level).
agent_jurisdiction(A, Level, J) :- nonvar(A), at_location(A, P), place_jurisdiction(P, Level, J).
forbids(Rule, A, Act, T) :- norm(Rule, _), jurisdiction_law(Rule, J), in_jurisdiction(A, J), rule_forbids_action(Rule, Act), rule_applies(Rule, A, T).

region_extent_contains(disc(Cx, Cz, Rad), X, Z) :- DX is X - Cx, DZ is Z - Cz, DX * DX + DZ * DZ =< Rad * Rad.
